_comment: Run economy and balance knobs. Supplies are run-only; credits persist in the profile and are banked at EndRun (failed runs bank credits.death_rate of what they earned).

refine._comment: Refining a gun one tier up (the rarity remake): a reward choice with reward_chance (always after an arena rated reward_rating), a shop offer with shop_chance, a chest's chest_chance on the gun in hand. Prices by the tier reached. Exotic opens once exotic_unlocked_by (a profile bosses_beaten key) is beaten. The chances are for a run of chances_for_arenas arenas: a longer run multiplies them by that over its own length (measured 2026-11-09 with rm_sim --refine, a focused buyer: legendary guns at the end, short about 0.9 and 2 in 12 percent of runs, long about 2.1 and 3 or 4 in 29 percent, marathon about 3). reward_rated_chance is the chance of the refine after an arena at reward_rating or better.

enemy_threat._comment: Arena threat (ROADMAP M3.4, written by scripts/write_threats.py). A spawn's threat is the higher of its class's and its weapon's (weapons by uWp class, the arm id 0x701NN's NN; none = no weapon). The first arena is level 1, later arenas their route's tier plus later_arena_bonus, up to max_level. The director fields only spawns at or under the level (a map without any falls back to its mildest), keeps at most max_alive_by_level of them alive, and lets specials in from specials_from_level; the run map puts a map on a node only when it can field enemies at that node's level.

run_rosters._comment: Run-planned rosters (ROADMAP M3.3, rm::PlanRunRosters). When a run starts, every arena of its map from from_arena on (boss arenas aside) adds enemy classes of other maps to its map's own: up to normal_guests normal ones and, once the arena's threat level lets specials in, special_guests specials, within max_classes classes in all, at or under the arena's threat level, preferring classes the run has not fielded yet. A guest is its home map's roster entry (guests: class -> home map key; only listed classes travel). Guests take normal_share of the normal picks and special_share of the special ones. The first arena keeps its map's own enemies: its stage loads before the run exists. The adapter loads each arena's classes with its stage, with their weapons and plagas.

ladder._comment: Run lengths (EconomyConfig::Ladder, written by scripts/write_perks.py). A length ends on its easy boss until it is beaten, then on a choice of easy or hard; beating a hard one opens the length whose unlocked_by names it. A run also fights every shorter length's boss at that length's arena. The finale is one more arena after its after length's boss in a run that beat a hard boss of every length in needs_hard. From growth_from_arena on, each arena adds budget_per_arena enemies, incoming_per_arena damage taken and toughness_per_arena (the player's damage divided by 1 + it) per step.
